name: factory-retro
description: Weekly-ish harness retrospective: digest the last 7 days of run evidence (telemetry report, terminal runs' dirs, decision log) in the live app-factory checkout, maintain the single ranked harness-improvement backlog at docs/process/harness-backlog.md (append new items, update statuses in place, reconcile against founder decisions), commit only that file, then post a short summary to the rig channel. No gates, no deploy, no spawned runs; cadence is manual via factory-run start.
